name: David
summary: David is a cofounder/operator at "Sherlock" (an app, IG @sherlock.search), working alongside cofounders Zach and Jesse. He reached out about getting Sherlock's banned/restricted Instagram accounts restored, diagnosing what is triggering the bans (main violation flagged as Fraud and Deception / financial crime, worsening after Meta's increased enforcement around POV/Meta-glasses content), and building a setup to post Sherlock content at scale without repeat bans. He's asked for pricing on GRO checks/removals, sent a Dropbox of content that survived on TikTok but was removed on IG, and got hit with another wave of bans/restrictions on 8/19. Status: hot, ready to buy — repeatedly chasing calls, says "we're ready to move" and has "tons of creators ready to move"; a Google Sheet of accounts was shared at the end of the thread.
key_facts: Company: Sherlock (app, IG @sherlock.search); cofounders Zach and Jesse also involved
